tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should be original manufacturer or authorized Agent/dealer of the OEM of the tendered material. The bidder should have minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing of the tendered material as on last date of bid submission. If the bidder is a OEM should upload the valid manufacturing registration certificate of Udhyog Adhar memorandum Certificate with Udhyog Adhar Number. If the bidder is a authorised dealer of the OEM than should upload the Udyog Adhar memorandum Certificate of both OEM and authorised dealer and autherised dealership certificate issued by the OEM.Date of commencement of Production in the registration certificate should be older than 3 years from last date for submission of Bids.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Udyog Adhar memorandum Certificate of both OEM and authorised dealer and autherised  dealership certificate issued by the OEM

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied at least 80% tendered quantity in any one of the preceding 3 financial years. However it is 40% for Micro & Small Enterprises in any one of previous 2 financial years. For supply of the C type wedge connectors, Paddles and CT connectors of ratings Lynx or above Supplied to any of the state/Central owned Transmission Utilities.Genaration Utilities/PSUs.The bidder Should upload Order completion certificate duly mentioning year wise quantity supplied along with the Purchase Orders.The certificate should have been issued by the authority not lower than the rank of Executive Engineer. If the bidder is a authorized dealer then the bidder should upload Order completion and Purchase order of OEM or Dealer

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Order completion certificate and Purchase order

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactory performance for supply of the C type wedge connectors, Paddles and CT connectors of ratings Lynx or above for min period of 1 year as on last date of bid submission to any of the DISCOMs/ KPTCL/ Government / Boards / Corporations / Government Undertakings.The bidder should upload the satisfactory performance certificate clearly indicating min period of 1year satisfactory operation. It should have been Issued by the authority not lower than the rank of Executive Engineer. Duly mentioning the rating of the tendered material. If the bidder is a authorized dealer than the bidder should upload Performance Certificate of OEM or dealer
There should not be deviation in Technical specifications beyond permissible limits.The bidder should upload GTP and Drawing for the tendered material. The deviations should be within limit.

The bidder must furnish one sample of materials as per the standards on or before last date of bid submission. The samples received after the due date will not be considered and the bidder is liable for rejection.The sample will be subjected for verification and acceptance before the tender scrutiny committee. If the sample is rejected in the committee, the offer of the bidder of such samples will not be considered and the price bid of such bidders will not be opened.The bidder must submit the one sample of each tendered material before the last date of bid submission.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder shall submit the samples of tendered material within the specified time

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should upload type test reports for having conducted the relevant type tests mentioned in the Technical Specification as per tender documents on the Connectors suitable for Lynx or above at M/s. CPRI /ERDA or Government laboratories / any NABL accredited labs.The bidder should upload Type test reports of OEM issued from CPRI / ERDA/ Government testing labs any NABL accredited labs, not older than seven years as on date of bid opening.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Type test reports of OEM issued from CPRI / ERDA/ Government testing labs any NABL accredited labs

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have been blacklisted, defaulted or debarred from participating in tenders from any Govt dept.The bidder should upload self- declaration.

The bidder from Nations sharing Border with India should upload the certificate issued by GOI. OR self-declaration for not from Nations sharing Border with India.The bidder should upload the certificate issued by GOI OR Self- Declaration

Litigation History .The tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of bid. The bidder should upload the self-declaration.

The bidder should have Average annual Turn-over not less than 100% of APT during previous 3 Financial Years i.e 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. However it is 50% of APT for Micro & Small Enterprises during previous 2 Financial years ie 2023-24 & 2024-25.The bidder should upload Annual Turn-over certificate with UDIN number issued by CA. Audited balance sheet and audited profit & Loss accounts for the previous financial Year shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual audited report, P&L statement and Balance sheet

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have credit facility not less than 25% of Amount put to tender. However it will be 12.5% in respect of Micro and small Enterprises.The bidder should upload Credit facility certificate as per format Annexure A obtained on or after notification of tender issued by any Nationalized/ Scheduled commercial bank. Only Cash at bank, Term Deposits and available Fund based Credit /OD facility will be considered. The conditional Credit certificates are liable for rejection
